description: This file defines a MappingProfile class using AutoMapper to map entities like CatalogItem, CatalogType, and CatalogBrand to their respective Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for use in the Public API layer of the application.

classes.name: MappingProfile
classes.description: A class inheriting from AutoMapper's Profile, responsible for configuring object-object mappings between domain entities and their DTOs.

methods.name: MappingProfile
methods.description: Constructor that defines create map configurations for CatalogItem, CatalogType, and CatalogBrand entities to their respective DTOs.
